actors.name: uk-company-search
actors.title: UK Company Register Search
actors.description: Search the UK company register by the start of a name, company number, status, country or industry code. Register facts only, no contacts.

q.title: Company name starts with
q.description: Matched from the start of the registered name.

events.name: search-with-results
events.title: Search with results
events.description: One search that returns at least one company, up to 100 rows.

returns: Company name, number, status, type and incorporation date
Jurisdiction, registered address town and country, industry codes
Whether the register holds persons of significant control for the company
actors.limits: Covers the UK register only. The data is held from the register and can lag behind it; check the official register before relying on a record. At least one filter is needed.

actors.name: work-email-finder
actors.title: Work Email Finder
actors.description: Find the most likely work email for a named person at a company domain, with a verification status. Charged only when an address is found.

website.title: Company website
website.description: The company's domain, for example example.com.

name.title: Person's name
name.description: First and last name of the person.

events.name: email-found
events.title: Email found
events.description: One email address returned for your input.

returns: The email address
A verification status: verified, risky or invalid
When it was checked
actors.limits: A status is not a delivery guarantee. Use the addresses only where the law allows you to contact that person, and honour opt-outs. The address in the sample is masked.

actors.name: us-federal-contractor-check
actors.title: US Federal Contractor Check
actors.description: Check one US federal contractor against the official public records: registration, totals, largest contracts and, in full mode, tables by year and agency.

company.title: Contractor
company.description: A company name, a 12-character UEI or a 5-character CAGE code.

mode.title: Depth
mode.description: Snapshot: registration, five-year totals, top five contracts, one verdict. Full: adds tables by year and agency, active contracts, modifications and subcontracts.

returns: Registration details and how the contractor was matched
Five-year totals and the largest contracts, with record links
A plain verdict, and what was not checked
actors.limits: US federal records only, as of the date shown in the result. It is not legal advice and not a complete responsibility check: confirm exclusions on the official site before an award decision.

actors.name: us-nonprofit-check
actors.title: US Nonprofit Check
actors.description: Check one US tax-exempt organization using the IRS files: exemption status, revocation list and headline figures, with more detail in full mode.

ein.title: EIN
ein.description: Fill in either the EIN or the name.

name.title: Organization name
name.description: Fill in either the name or the EIN. A name that matches several organizations returns the candidates, free.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state, to narrow a name search.

mode.title: Depth
mode.description: Snapshot: status, latest headline figures, one verdict. Full: adds filings, ratios, people and grants where the returns carry them.

returns: Exemption status and whether the organization is on the revocation list
Latest headline figures from its returns
A plain verdict, and what the files do not cover
actors.limits: US organizations in the IRS files only. Returns are filed late by nature, so figures can be more than a year old.

actors.name: company-due-diligence-report
actors.title: Company Due Diligence Report
actors.description: A sourced due diligence report on one company, written for the decision you pick, such as buying from them, joining them or lending to them. Takes several minutes.

name.title: Company name
name.description: Fill in the name, the domain or both.

angle.title: Decision
enumTitles: Hiring the team by buying it
angle.description: The decision the report is written for.

country.title: Country
country.description: Where the company is, if the name is common.

events.name: company-report
events.title: Company report
events.description: One finished report. Set the run timeout to at least 30 minutes.

returns: The report as a web page, as Markdown and as structured sections
Links to the sources behind its statements
No charge when the company cannot be found
actors.limits: A research aid built from public information, which can be incomplete or out of date. It is not legal, credit or investment advice: open the sources before you decide.

actors.name: show-hn-best-time
actors.title: Show HN Best Time to Post
actors.description: How often Show HN posts reached 50 and 100 points: overall, for the best hour and day, and for the slot you ask about. Counts, not a prediction.
returns: The share of posts reaching 50 and 100 points, overall
The best hour and day
The same shares for your weekday and hour, with the number of posts behind them
actors.limits: Past shares are not a forecast for your post. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Hacker News.

actors.name: product-changelog-lookup
actors.title: Product Changelog Lookup
actors.description: The newest changelog entries held for a software product, each with date, title, a short summary and the vendor's own link.

limit.title: Entries
limit.description: How many of the newest entries.

events.name: changelog-lookup
events.title: Changelog lookup
events.description: One lookup of a tracked product that returns entries.

returns: Date and title of each entry
A short summary of each
The vendor's own link for each entry
actors.limits: Only tracked products have entries; an untracked product costs nothing. Entries can lag behind the vendor's page. Not affiliated with the vendors listed.

actors.name: sec-form-d-lookup
actors.title: SEC Form D Raise Lookup
actors.description: Look up one US private funding notice (SEC Form D) by its accession number, or a company's Form D history by its SEC CIK number.

accession.title: Accession number
accession.description: The SEC accession number of one Form D filing. Use this or the CIK.

cik.title: SEC CIK number
cik.description: The company's CIK, for its Form D history. Use this or the accession number.

events.name: form-d-found
events.title: Form D result
events.description: One Form D filing, or one company's Form D history, that was found.

returns: Issuer, address, industry and entity type as filed
Amount offered, amount sold, date of first sale, exemptions and amendment flag
People the filing names with their roles
A link to the filing on the SEC site
actors.limits: Held filings are US Form D, nearly all filed from 2022 on. Form D states no valuation and does not name the investors in a round. Amounts are what the company reported. Many raises are never reported on this form.

actors.name: us-layoff-notice-lookup
actors.title: US Layoff Notice (WARN) Lookup
actors.description: Find the US state layoff notices held for one company, by company name, website domain or SEC CIK number.

name.title: Company name
name.description: The company's legal or trading name. Give exactly one of name, domain or CIK.

domain.title: Website domain
domain.description: The company's domain, for example example.com.

cik.title: SEC CIK number
cik.description: The company's CIK, for companies that file with the SEC.

events.name: layoff-notices-found
events.title: Company with layoff notices
events.description: One company lookup that returns at least one layoff notice.

returns: Each notice held: state, city, employees, notice and effective dates, type
The company name as filed, how it was matched and a source link
How the company you asked for was identified
actors.limits: State layoff notices only, as published by the states we read; coverage and history differ by state and small layoffs may need no notice. A name can belong to more than one company: check the match details. No notice found does not prove there were no layoffs. No employee is named.

actors.name: sec-8k-executive-changes
actors.title: SEC 8-K Executive Changes
actors.description: Appointments and departures that US public companies report on Form 8-K, Item 5.02, one record per filing.

company.title: Company name
company.description: Words from the company name; every word must appear as a whole word.

accession.title: Accession number
accession.description: One exact filing. Send it on its own.

filed_from.title: Filed from
filed_from.description: Filings filed on or after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

filed_to.title: Filed to
filed_to.description: Filings filed on or before this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

page_size.title: Most filings to return
page_size.description: From 1 to 25. You pay for each filing returned.

events.name: filing-returned
events.title: Filing returned
events.description: Charged once for each filing returned.

returns: Company, CIK and tickers
Each named change: person, role, appointed or departed, effective date and the filing's own sentence
Links to the filing and the document, and the filing date
actors.limits: Coverage starts on 2 January 2026. Role and effective date are read from the filing's sentence and are empty when it does not state them; some filings name nobody in a readable sentence. Private companies do not file Form 8-K. Check the linked filing before acting.

actors.name: us-company-ownership
actors.title: US Public Company Ownership
actors.description: Who holds a US public company according to its SEC filings: large holder reports, insider holdings and acquisition reports.

ticker.title: Ticker
ticker.description: The ticker the SEC's list gives the company today. Give exactly one of ticker, CIK or company.

company.title: Company name
company.description: Words from the name. If several companies match, you get the list and no charge.

events.name: ownership-record
events.title: Ownership record
events.description: One company's ownership record that was found.

returns: Reports of large holdings (Schedules 13D and 13G)
Insider holdings from Forms 3, 4 and 5
Acquisition reports the company filed, each with its date and filing link
actors.limits: Quarterly institutional holdings (Form 13F) are not included. No parent company is worked out. Share figures are as filed on their dates, not today's positions. US SEC filers only.

actors.name: startup-investor-directory
actors.title: Startup Investor Directory Search
actors.description: Search a directory of startup investors by sector, stage, region and cheque size, or fetch one record by its slug.

stage.title: Stage
stage.description: For example pre seed, seed or series a.

region.title: Region
region.description: NA, EU, APAC, ME or OFFSHORE.

q.title: Free text
q.description: Searches name, thesis and firm description.

thesis.title: Thesis words
thesis.description: Words that must appear in the stated thesis.

check_size_min.title: Cheque reaches at least (USD)
check_size_min.description: Only investors whose stated range reaches this amount.

check_size_max.title: Cheque starts at or below (USD)
check_size_max.description: Only investors whose stated range starts at or below this amount.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: One exact record. Use it on its own.

events.name: investor-search-with-results
events.title: Search with results
events.description: One search that returns at least one investor, up to 100 rows.

returns: Name, location, stated thesis and thesis summary
Recent sectors and stages, stated cheque range
Public profile and website links where held
actors.limits: No email addresses or private contact details are returned. Records can lag behind what an investor is doing now, and some cheque ranges are unstated (shown as 0). Some records are people: use them only where the law allows and honour opt-outs. A search that returns nothing is not charged.
